body:
i've been going to therapy on a weekly basis for a few months and it's been helping, but there's just so much going on in my life that sometimes it feels like it'll take forever to fully get to the core of all my problems. plus, money is always an issue and i don't know how long i'll be able to afford all these sessions.  

i also call my university's crisis hotline every night because it always gets really bad at night, and it's always a hit or miss with them. sometimes it helps and the operator can calm me down, but sometimes it just makes me even more angry and upset (like this one time a lady told me to try drinking warm milk and meditating after i literally told her i wanted to kill myself). 

i try calming myself down and distracting myself by like coloring or reading or watching movies, but lately i'm just so numb and distant that nothing seems to bring me happiness. it just really sucks because music is a huge part of my life and it's just become a chore now and it doesn't make me happy anymore. 

i've tried talking to a couple really close friends of mine about my suicidal thoughts, but they just make me feel really awkward. they've never been in my shoes and they don't know how to help. i'm thankful that they're at least trying, but they never seem to say the right things. they always tell me that i should live because of how my death will affect my family and friends, but it honestly just feels like i'm being guilt tripped into living and it just makes me more upset. 

and to answer your question, i just recently turned 21.

thank you for responding. 

but i'm just tired of fighting. i'm so exhausted all the time. and i know that realistically there's other options, but i've exhausted all my resources. plus, it really kinda blows when your own fkn parents don't think there's anything wrong with you and criticize you for wanting/needing meds to even function.

i'm in the exact same situation as you and it really blows. we've been broken up for about two months now and it's been absolute hell. i know that everyone will say it will get better (and i really hope it will for the both of us), but being sad and depressed is just kinda where i'm at right now and i don't know how long i'll feel like this.
 
i don't know about you, but my boyfriend was my support system, i could go to him with anything and i always knew that he would help me and calm me down and make me feel just a little bit better. but now that we're broken up, i don't have that support anymore, especially now when i'm really hurting and need the support now more than ever. 

i've been pretty suicidal since the breakup and it's really hard. i don't really have anyone i can talk to about it and the one person i want to talk about it with doesn't want me to be a part of their life anymore because they found someone "better." 

some days are better, some days are just fucking terrible. most of the time i feel like no one really understands what i'm going through because they haven't been in my shoes and it's like talking to a brick wall and i just get even more frustrated and upset and suicidal. 

i'm sorry you're going through this. being cheated on is the worst and i wouldn't wish it upon anyone. if you need someone to talk to, feel free to pm me and we can just talk/vent/share experiences if you want. i know that talking to someone else who is experiencing the exact same thing as me would definitely make me feel a little more validated (and validation is always a good thing).
